description.en: RDF version of the Apertium bilingual dictionary EO-EN. The original dataset (in LMF) comes from http://hdl.handle.net/10230/22863 . The RDF version of the lexica is modelled using lemon (http://lemon-model.net/) and the translation module (http://purl.org/net/translation). More about the Apertium RDF dictionaries at http://linguistic.linkeddata.es/apertium/

contact_point.name: Jacob Nordfalk ; Universitat Pompeu Fabra. Institut Universitari de Lingüística Aplicada (IULA) ; Universitat d'Alacant. Grup Transducens ; Hector Alòs i Font

other_download.title: Zipped Dump
other_download.description: It contains two lexicons (EO, EN) and the Translation Set EO-EN, as well as the metadata file.

other_download.title: Esperanto lexicon URI
other_download.description: This online lexicon not only contains the EO lexical entries from the EO-EN bilingual dictionary (that can be found in the zipped dump) but also aggregates the lexical entries in EO coming from all the published Apertium RDF dictionaries.

other_download.title: English lexicon URI
other_download.description: This online lexicon not only contains the EN lexical entries from the EO-EN bilingual dictionary (that can be found in the zipped dump) but also aggregates the lexical entries in EN coming from all the published Apertium RDF dictionaries.

other_download.title: Dataset description in DCAT
other_download.description: This extends the metadata in http://datahub.io/dataset/apertium-rdf-eo-en.rdf with licence and provenance.
